faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Record Clerk posts in TNRD Ramanathapuram Recruitment 2026?

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for TNRD Ramanathapuram Record Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the TNRD Ramanathapuram Record Clerk Recruitment 2026 is 30 September 2026. Candidates are advised to complete their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Record Clerk posts in TNRD Ramanathapuram?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Record Clerk post must be between 18 and 37 years of age. Age relaxation is applicable for certain categories as per government norms, including PWD and Ex-Servicemen.

faq.answer: The essential qualification for the Record Clerk post under TNRD Ramanathapuram Recruitment 2026 is a 10th Pass certificate. Candidates must meet this educational requirement to be eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Record Clerk position in TNRD Ramanathapuram?
faq.answer: The salary for the Record Clerk position in TNRD Ramanathapuram ranges from Rs. 15900 to Rs. 58600 per month. This corresponds to Pay Level-02, offering a competitive remuneration package.

faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category, including General/OBC and SC/ST, for the TNRD Ramanathapuram Record Clerk Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without any cost.

faq.answer: The selection process for Record Clerk posts in TNRD Ramanathapuram involves an Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates will be assessed based on their performance in these stages.
